title: Gilas Girls notch historic win over Kiwis in Fiba U18 Women's Asia Cup

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Gilas Pilipinas Girls made history on Tuesday after stunning New Zealand, 69-64, in the Fiba U18 Women’s Asia Cup at Karisma Arena in Malaysia. The win, which was Gilas’ first since being promoted to Division A, also gave the Philippines a ticket to the qualification for a semifinal spot in the continental meet. Down by one, UST standout Riri Perez muscled her way for a basket and a foul to put Gilas in front, 65-64, with 50 ticks to go.
